targets.rawSql:
SELECT mm.incentive AS incentives, b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND h.hotkey = '${miner}'
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY b.timestamp

SELECT MAX(mm.incentive) AS "max incentives", b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND (ns.is_immune OR ns.has_any_weights)
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
GROUP BY b.timestamp
ORDER BY b.timestamp

SELECT MAX(mm.incentive) AS "top immune", b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND ns.is_immune
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
GROUP BY b.timestamp
ORDER BY b.timestamp

SELECT DISTINCT ON (b.timestamp) mm.incentive AS "newest immune", b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY b.timestamp, n.first_seen_block DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT inn.val AS "deregistration zone", inn.time
FROM (
  SELECT b.timestamp AS time,
    mm.incentive AS val,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.timestamp ORDER BY mm.incentive ASC) AS rn
  FROM metagraph_neuron n
    JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
    JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
    WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
    AND NOT ns.is_immune
    AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
  GROUP BY b.timestamp, mm.incentive
) inn
WHERE inn.rn = 4

SELECT inn.val AS "deregistration zone 8", inn.time
FROM (
  SELECT b.timestamp AS time,
    mm.incentive AS val,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.timestamp ORDER BY mm.incentive ASC) AS rn
  FROM metagraph_neuron n
    JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
    JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
    WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
    AND NOT ns.is_immune
    AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
  GROUP BY b.timestamp, mm.incentive
) inn
WHERE inn.rn = 8

SELECT AVG(w.weight) AS "honest", b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron mn
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey mh ON mh.id = mn.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_weight w ON w.target_neuron_id = mn.id AND w.mech_id = ${mech_id} AND w.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND w.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT AVG(w.weight) AS "WC", b.timestamp AS time

  JOIN metagraph_hotkey mh ON mh.id = mn.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_weight w ON w.target_neuron_id = mn.id AND w.mech_id = ${mech_id} AND w.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND w.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT inn.rn AS "main", inn.time
FROM (
  SELECT b.timestamp AS time, h.hotkey,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.timestamp ORDER BY ns.emissions ASC, n.first_seen_block ASC) AS rn
  FROM metagraph_neuron n
    JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
    JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
    JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
    AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
  GROUP BY h.hotkey, b.timestamp, ns.emissions, n.first_seen_block
) inn
WHERE inn.hotkey = '${miner}'

SELECT mid.rn AS "lowest", mid.time
FROM (
  SELECT inn.rn, inn.time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inn.time ORDER BY inn.rn ASC) AS mid_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT ns.is_immune, b.timestamp AS time, h.hotkey,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.timestamp ORDER BY ns.emissions ASC) AS rn
    FROM metagraph_neuron n
      JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
      JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
      JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
    WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
      AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
    GROUP BY h.hotkey, b.timestamp, ns.emissions, ns.is_immune
  ) inn
  WHERE NOT inn.is_immune
  GROUP BY inn.time, inn.rn
) mid
WHERE mid.mid_rank = 1

SELECT mid.rn AS "dereg", mid.time
FROM (
  SELECT inn.rn, inn.time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inn.time ORDER BY inn.rn ASC) AS mid_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT ns.is_immune, b.timestamp AS time, h.hotkey,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.timestamp ORDER BY ns.emissions ASC) AS rn
    FROM metagraph_neuron n
      JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
      JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
      JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
    WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
      AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
    GROUP BY h.hotkey, b.timestamp, ns.emissions, ns.is_immune
  ) inn
  WHERE NOT inn.is_immune
  GROUP BY inn.time, inn.rn
) mid
WHERE mid.mid_rank = 4

SELECT mid.rn AS "danger", mid.time
FROM (
  SELECT inn.rn, inn.time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inn.time ORDER BY inn.rn ASC) AS mid_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT ns.is_immune, b.timestamp AS time, h.hotkey,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.timestamp ORDER BY ns.emissions ASC) AS rn
    FROM metagraph_neuron n
      JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
      JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
      JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
    WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
      AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
    GROUP BY h.hotkey, b.timestamp, ns.emissions, ns.is_immune
  ) inn
  WHERE NOT inn.is_immune
  GROUP BY inn.time, inn.rn
) mid
WHERE mid.mid_rank = 8

SELECT mid.rn AS "top immune", mid.time
FROM (
  SELECT inn.rn, inn.time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inn.time ORDER BY inn.rn DESC) AS mid_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT ns.is_immune, b.timestamp AS time, h.hotkey,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.timestamp ORDER BY mm.incentive ASC) AS rn
    FROM metagraph_neuron n
      JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
      JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
      JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
      JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
    WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
      AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
    GROUP BY h.hotkey, b.timestamp, mm.incentive, ns.is_immune
  ) inn
  WHERE inn.is_immune
  GROUP BY inn.time, inn.rn
) mid
WHERE mid.mid_rank = 1

SELECT ns.total_stake / 1e9 AS total_stake, b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND h.hotkey = '${miner}'
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY b.timestamp

SELECT mm.consensus, ns.rank, b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  LEFT JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = 0
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND h.hotkey = '${miner}'
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY b.timestamp

SELECT ns.trust AS "our trust", b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND h.hotkey = '${miner}'
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY b.timestamp

SELECT AVG(ns.trust) AS "avg trust", b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND (ns.is_immune OR ns.has_any_weights)
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
GROUP BY b.timestamp

SELECT ns.emissions / 1e9 AS emissions, b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND h.hotkey = '${miner}'
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY b.timestamp

SELECT mm.consensus, b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
  LEFT JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = 0
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND h.hotkey = '${miner}'
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY b.timestamp

SELECT COUNT(*) AS immune, b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND ns.is_immune
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
GROUP BY b.timestamp

SELECT bo.bond AS " ", b.timestamp AS time,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(vh.label, ''), NULLIF(ck.label, ''), ck.identity_name, vh.hotkey) AS validator
FROM metagraph_neuron mn
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey mh ON mh.id = mn.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_bond bo ON bo.target_neuron_id = mn.id AND bo.mech_id = ${mech_id} AND bo.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND bo.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_neuron vn ON vn.id = bo.source_neuron_id
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey vh ON vh.id = vn.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_coldkey ck ON ck.id = vh.coldkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = bo.block_id
WHERE mh.hotkey = '${miner}' AND mn.subnet_id = ${subnet}
  AND vn.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND vn.id != mn.id
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
